//: docs/09-landing-site.md §8 — the performance budget, enforced. A breach fails the build. Defaults are Lighthouse's mobile emulation with throttling, which is what the budget table is written against; do not switch this to the desktop preset to make a number go green.

settings.//: Two audits are meaningless here and would fail every run: the page is served over plain HTTP from a throwaway process, and its assets are local files with no CDN in front of them.

assertions.//js: 70 KB gzipped. Lighthouse reports transfer size, which is the gzipped figure nginx would send.
assertions.//fonts: Two families, four files. The budget is a count, not a size.
assertions.//a11y: Accessibility is 100 or the build fails — these are the rows that most often take it below.
assertions.label: error
